environment_rule: No generic 'corrosion resistant' label is sufficient for design approval.

comparative_principles.zirconium: exceptional in selected chemical-process environments but sensitive to specific chemistry, hydrogen and temperature limits
comparative_principles.nickel_corrosion_alloys: broad capability but selection depends strongly on oxidising/reducing chemistry and localized-corrosion mechanisms
comparative_principles.MP35N: corrosion resistance must be assessed alongside its high-strength condition
comparative_principles.Nitinol: surface chemistry and processing are particularly important for corrosion performance in biomedical applications
